title: Overwatch 2 Really, Really, Really Balanced Patch Notes - April 1, 2024

sections.title: Patch Update
sections.description: We are currently aware of an issue that these balance changes are only reflected in a game mode that appears in the arcade. So we’re gonna call it “Balanced Overwatch” for now. Sorry for any confusion. There are also some new challenges that are granting some of our developer’s doodles as sprays. We’re not sure why that is happening, but they are really cool looking. You might want to collect them as quickly as possible because this is planned to be fixed by April 8.

blocks.title: GENERAL UPDATES
blocks.body: - Maximum ultimate charge preserved on hero swap increased from 15 to 49%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Mech go zoom and D.Va bomb go boom.

changes.text_en: Can now move backwards.
Can now be canceled with Crouch.
Canceling the ability with Crouch in the first .4 seconds reduces the cooldown to 1.5 seconds.
Knockback increased by 900%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Doomfist is a mobility hero, so there’s no reason he should be slowing down while blocking right?

general.text_en: Power Block and Meteor Strike also empower your next Quick Melee.

changes.text_en: Movement Speed Modifier increased from .65x to 1.25x.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Leave it to Junker Queen to cut her way toward new heights.

changes.text_en: Pressing Secondary Fire while the ability is active now magnetizes Junker Queen to Gracie.
Cooldown now starts when blade starts returning to Junker Queen.
Cooldown decreased from 6 to 4 seconds.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Smallga

general.text_en: Mauga’s Scale has been reduced by 50%.

changes.text_en: Hitting enemies who are ‘On Fire’ will Ignite them.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Efi has made some changes to Orisa’s technology inspired by a completely hypothetical scenario where a certain archer rides her into battle.

changes.text_en: Ricochets once.
Explodes when it sticks.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: We heard Ramattra wasn’t suffering enough so we’ve increased his suffering so that when he causes suffering his enemies will suffer as much as he has suffered.

changes.text_en: Moved from his Ultimate to Ability 1
No longer pauses its duration while dealing damage.
Movement Speed Increased by 20%.
Duration increased from 3 to 5 seconds.
Damage Per Second Decreased from 30 to 20.
Radius decreased from 12 to 9 meters.
Moved from his Ability 1 to his Ultimate.
Always has Annihilation active while in use.
Fully heals Ramattra on use.
Pummel Damage increased from 60 to 75.
Pummel Range has been increased from 10 to 15.

heroes.dev_note: Reinhardt Comment: HAHA! THIS IS JUST LIKE PING PONG! WATCH THIS, BRIGITTE! I WILL BE ENTERING THE CHAMPIONSHIP THIS YEAR!

changes.text_en: You can now press Primary Fire to reflects projectiles.
Health decreases by 20% every second while reflecting.
Barrier size decreased to 50% while Reflecting.
Camera Lock input now bound to Quick Melee.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Much to the chagrin of his enemies, Roadhog has recently discovered baseball.

changes.text_en: Projectile Speed increased from 26 to 80.
Projectile Damage increased from 0 to 40.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Danger! Falling rocks.

changes.text_en: Projectile Speed decreased from 37 to 30.
Projectile Gravity decreased from 18 to 2.
Pressing the ability button while Accretion is active will cause the rock to crash into the ground. When crashed, it will deal 50 damage in a 4-meter radius and stun anyone damaged.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Empowering the “no aim” playstyle.

changes.text_en: Secondary Fire now chains between enemies.
Punches also cause lightning to chain between enemies.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: We're preparing to retcon Wrecking Ball into a crab. Hope these changes are sufficiently immersive.

general.text_en: Wrecking Ball’s sideways movement speed increased by 55%.
general.subject: move_speed

changes.text_en: Deals increased damage as you continue to walk sideways.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Please don’t burst Zarya’s bubble, no matter how big it gets.

general.text_en: Developer Comments: Please don’t burst Zarya’s bubble, no matter how big it gets.

changes.text_en: Increases the size of the bubbled target by 1.75x.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: B.O.B.’s upset from being called the wrong name, so F.R.E.D.’s picking up the slack.

changes.text_en: New Ability on mouse scroll.
Weapon Swap.
Call in F.R.E.D. to charge for a short duration before leaving.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Yeah, we’ve switched up his configurations a little. So anyway, start blastin'.

changes.text_en: Configuration: Assault is now the default form.
Movement speed penalty has been removed.
Configuration: Assault now has 150 Ammo.
Damage per bullet decreased from 12 to 5.
Now deals 1.5x damage for critical hits.
Now transforms Bastion into Configuration: Recon.
Grants a movement speed bonus of 35%.
Configuration: Sentry now fires shotgun blasts.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Extra survivability is every cowboy’s dream – just don’t die.

changes.text_en: New Passive
One enemy is marked. Kill them to gain 50 health until the next time you die. After 5 kills, you gain 1 health each time.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Now bringing Mystery Heroes into other modes.

changes.text_en: Targets within 8 meters of Echo take damage as if they’re under half health.
Can no longer choose who you duplicate.
Can now duplicate allies.
Duplicate’s Health no longer capped at 300 health.
Duplicate now gains an extra 100 Shields.
Bonus Ult Charge Gain Rate increased from 4 to 6.5.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Parry this! *Not exclusive to casual players.

changes.text_en: Press Primary Fire with perfect timing to critically deflect a projectile.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Hanzo has always struggled to overcome his past, so it’s hard for him not to bounce back to old habits.

changes.text_en: Number of ricochets increased from 1 to 3.
Number of projectiles per shot increased from 1 to 5.
Damage of each projectile decreased by 78%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Junkrat put bombs on his bombs. Not sure why this would surprise anybody.

changes.text_en: You can now detonate Frag Launcher projectiles with Secondary Fire.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Request: Definitely do not use this to get to spots on the map you’re not supposed to get to, thanks.

changes.text_en: New Ability.
Press Jump in the Air to activate.
Creates a large Ice Pillar under Mei.
Can be canceled with Interact.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: You’ve used Hover Jets. You’ve used Jump Jets. You’ve used Jet Dash. But have you tried Jet Land?

changes.text_en: New Ability.
Press Crouch in the Air to activate.
Dash downwards towards the ground.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Someone’s taken a page out of Mauga’s book.

changes.text_en: Primary Fire now only shoots one shotgun.
Damage per bullet reduced from 5.4 to 2.8.
Ammo increased from 8 to 16.
Secondary Fire now shoots the other shotgun.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Vivian Chase? More like Vivian Pull.

changes.text_en: Disruptor Shot now pulls enemies in on deploy.
You can deploy Disruptor Shot early by pressing E again.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Run and gun? Sounds like fun!

changes.text_en: Can now be used during Sprint.
Using Heavy Pulse Rifle while sprinting has a spread of 2.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: To keep fights fair, let the enemy team know that they should update their network anti-virus and firewalls as soon as possible.

changes.text_en: Killing an enemy infected with Virus, it attempts to spread to a nearby enemy.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Symmetra can’t troll you if you don’t press Teleport.

changes.text_en: Only places exit Teleporter.
Any ally can use Teleporter regardless of their location.
Teleporter duration decreased from 10 to 4 seconds.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Everyone deserves a pet turret.

changes.text_en: The turret now sticks to walls, ceilings, and allies.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: krow slotsiP esluP ruoy woh gnignahc ,erutuf ro tsap eht ot uoy sdnes ylmodnaR

changes.text_en: Randomly sends you to the past or future, changing how your Pulse Pistols work.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Hooks + Headshot = Parkour

changes.text_en: Now has 3 charges.
Getting a critical hit with Widow’s Kiss’s secondary fire replenishes one charge of the ability.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Rise and shine! How’s this for a rude awakening?

changes.text_en: Slept enemies slowly rise while Sleeping.
Enemies take fall damage when they land.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Someone once advised Baptiste to keep moving forward. He’s really taken that advice to heart.

changes.text_en: Now launches you forward rather than upward.
Increases speed of projectiles shot through it by 200%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Bigitte

changes.text_en: Health increased from 250 to 700.
Always uses bigger size.
Resets your Shield Bash cooldown.
Movement Speed bonus increased from 1.15x to 1.3x.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Fixing a longstanding Illari bug, her solar powers are now fully functional.

changes.text_en: After using Captive Sun, Illari becomes Solar Installed. She moves faster and charges her Solar Rifle Faster, her rifle always charges to full damage power.
Movement speed bonus 1.2x.
Attack charge time reduced by 40%.
Healing recharge bonus 1.2x.
New Passive.
Illari is always Solar Installed when the sun is out.

heroes.dev_note: Dev Comment: You should see her on her trampoline.

changes.text_en: Now also grants allies a 10% damage boost, 10% healing boost, 50% movement speed boost, and 700% increased jump height.
Increased duration from .65 to 1 second.
New Passive
Kiriko can jump an extra time in the air

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Reach new heights with Lifeweaver through the power of photosynthesis.

changes.text_en: Now raises 20m (up from 8m).

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Lucio’s gun is now keepin’ it in time.

changes.text_en: Ammo increased from 20 to 30.
Recovery decreased from .14 seconds per bullet to .125 seconds per bullet.
Now Shoots 3 bullets per volley during Speed Boost and 5 bullets per volley during Healing Boost.
Knocks up enemies the sound waves hit.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Goodbye, 0 damage numbers!

changes.text_en: Damage boost from Secondary Fire removed.
Secondary Fire is now Damage Staff. (Ability 2 on Controller.)
Damage Staff Fires Caduceus Blaster projectiles.
Projectiles have a smaller size.
Size gets bigger during ult.
2 more damage.
Projectiles reload automatically while not firing.
Projectiles reload at twice the speed while healing or after 4 seconds without firing.
Can fire projectiles at a reduced firing speed if healing beam is active.
Healing beam can heal at a reduced rate if Damage Staff is active.
Removed.

heroes.dev_note: Dev Comment: Moira’s right arm is starting to melt from all the experimentation, so she’s switching it up.

changes.text_en: Now deals damage instead of healing.
Now heals instead of doing damage.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: “Let Zen walk?” Not sure about that one.

changes.text_en: Ammo increased from 25 to 32.
Secondary Fire charge time per projectile decreased from .52 to .47.
Secondary Fire projectiles fire 33% faster.
Secondary Fire damage decreased by 30%.
You can now charge up to 8 Orbs with Secondary Fire.
Zenyatta’s accelerates upward while charging Secondary Fire.
